self_review.findings: No remaining issue found in this scoped diff. Fresh events retain the existing path. Stale and future-dated trade updates fail before event normalization; the session failure control is ConnectionStatus::Failed. Provider entitlement, provider subscription ACK and P6 remain unverified.

defect.evidence: Before this change EventProjector.trade generation-fenced the update but ignored TradeUpdate.freshness, then built a normal OptionTrade event. The low-level lane retained Stale/FutureDated labels, while the shared event schema has no freshness field.
defect.root_cause: The adapter boundary discarded freshness when projecting into a shared contract that cannot represent it.
defect.fix: Reject every freshness value other than Fresh with ProtocolViolation before constructing the normalized event. Existing error handling publishes Failed connection control and terminates the session.
defect.rollback_condition: Keep this rejection unless a reviewed versioned shared contract carries explicit freshness and consumers prove stale/future handling end to end. Revert only if a regression demonstrates Fresh updates are rejected; otherwise rollback must retain fail-closed behavior.

acceptance.limits: No real SIP/OPRA subscription, entitlement probe, remote storage, broker connection or trading operation was used.
